normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only the amount fed into the KP3R approve/swap sequence in _swap
pair is only the target address used by _update to write an Observation
_point is a temporary copy of lastObservation inside _update
timeElapsed is the block.timestamp delta computed inside _update
x is the sole input of the sqrt routine
numbers is the array consumed by stddev
sum is the accumulator used only inside stddev
mean is the intermediate value computed only inside stddev
granularity is used only for the loop bound and final division in quote
tokenIn only selects the pair/token ordering in current
amountIn is only forwarded to computeAmountOut by current
tokenOut only selects the pair direction in current
priceCumulativeStart is only the lower bound of the delta in computeAmountOut
priceCumulativeEnd is only the upper bound of the delta in computeAmountOut
timeElapsed is only the divisor used by computeAmountOut
priceAverage is a temporary FixedPoint value local to computeAmountOut
